column1: # The 40 golden photos (spec, Fixtures: 40 files across JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, TIFF and GIF, 10 targets and 4 screenshots).
# Written by hand. Columns: path (under golden/), format, role (target|other|screenshot), c1, c2, c3, objects, text.
# photo roles: c1 sky top, c2 sky bottom, c3 ground (- for none); objects glyph:cx,cy,size;... (fractions); text -
# screenshot role: c1 page, c2 title bar, c3 text colour; objects -; text lines joined by |, {EXACT} is replaced by
#   the query of every exact row of fixtures/answers.csv with the note screenshot-only whose file is this path.
# The targets must be exactly the files of the photo rows of answers.csv and the screenshots exactly the files of its
# screenshot-only rows (kit-fixtures.sh build stops when they differ). Formats: jpeg 7, png 11, heic 6, webp 6, tiff 5, gif 5.
